name: Test tool
purpose: Demonstration harness for the connected design tool protocol, not a real design tool: returns the selected tower 4 m wider with a 3 % taper.

sends: the selected tower: name, size, storeys, podium, footprint
destination.to: the Toolkit's own test page, served from this computer (localhost:5499)
destination.stores: nothing: the page keeps the inputs in memory until it is closed

limits: Demonstration only: the change is fixed (4 m wider, 3 % taper), not a design
Returns rectangular plates; the tower keeps its Toolkit position and rotation
